prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production pixel character sprite sheet for the existing 2D tavern browser game The Moonlit Tankard.
Input image 1 is the character identity reference. Input image 2 is the existing game's staff sprite sheet, used ONLY for pixel rendering style, scale, outline and shading, not character identity.
Primary request: pixelize the blue-haired whale maid from input image 1 as ONE recognizable tavern employee, showing four animation poses of exactly the same character on a real transparent background.
Identity invariants: cheerful chibi girl, large blue eyes, dark slate-blue long wavy hair with light blue ends, one curved ahoge, white frilled maid headband, small pale-blue hair bow, blue side fins, navy maid dress with understated gold trim and bows, white frilly apron with a tiny navy whale symbol, dark shoes, curved blue whale tail with a fin extending to her right. Preserve her cute rounded proportions and all these defining features while simplifying fine ornament into readable pixel clusters. All four poses must match clothing, hairstyle, colors, head size and body size.
Pixel medium: authentic clean hand-crafted game pixel art, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, intentional stepped dark navy outlines, restricted coherent palette around 28 colors, hard edges, 3 shade levels per material, no antialiasing or smooth vector curves, no blur, no painted gradients, no photographic texture. Think a native character around 96-112 pixels tall shown enlarged with nearest-neighbor edges; match the other cozy staff sprites while retaining this character's identity.
Composition: ONE square 2-column by 2-row sprite sheet, exactly 4 full-body sprites centered in 4 equally sized cells with generous fully transparent gutters and safe margins, equal character scale, same local foot baseline in every cell, no clipping of hair, ahoge, fins or tail.
Top left: front-facing neutral idle, arms relaxed and available for interaction.
Top right: front-facing walk frame A, left foot forward, small natural arm swing.
Bottom left: front-facing walk frame B, right foot forward, opposite arm swing.
Bottom right: directly rear-facing idle, showing the back of headband and long blue hair, apron ties and whale tail, absolutely no front face showing.
Lighting: neutral sprite lighting, softly warm highlights, legible against dark blue nighttime tavern floor.
Background: actual RGBA transparency, no colored background, no baked checkerboard.
Avoid: extra characters, extra objects, tray or drink props, text, numbers, labels, borders, cell lines, watermark, drop shadow, floor, exaggerated 3D rendering, overly intricate subpixel detail. Output only the four pixel sprites.
